text: confederate with Ephraim: Heb. resteth on Ephraim
Shearjashub: that is, The remnant shall return | in the highway: Or, causeway
neither be fainthearted: Heb. let not thine heart be tender
that it be not a people: Heb. from a people
if ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established: Or, do ye not believe? it is because ye are not stable
moreover the LORD spake: Heb. and the Lord added to speak
ask it either in the depth: Or, make thy petion deep
a virgin...shall call: Or, thou, O virgin, shalt call
in the land: Heb. in the midst of the land
